description: This file defines the interface for managing a stack of reftables, including functions for creating, modifying, iterating, compacting, and cleaning the stack, as well as managing transactions and retrieving statistics.

methods.name: reftable_new_stack
methods.description: Open a new reftable stack stored in the specified directory with given options.

methods.name: reftable_stack_next_update_index
methods.description: Retrieve the next update index for writing a new table on the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_new_addition
methods.description: Begin a new transaction to add reftables to the stack, locking the reference database.

methods.name: reftable_addition_add
methods.description: Add a reftable to the current transaction.

methods.name: reftable_addition_commit
methods.description: Commit the current transaction, releasing the lock.

methods.name: reftable_addition_destroy
methods.description: Abort and deallocate the current transaction, releasing any held resources.

methods.name: reftable_stack_add
methods.description: Add a new reftable to the stack within a transaction.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initialize an iterator for refs in the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initialize an iterator for logs in the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_merged_table
methods.description: Get the current merged table representing the stack state.

methods.name: reftable_stack_destroy
methods.description: Free resources associated with the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_reload
methods.description: Reload the stack if it is out-of-date.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compact_all
methods.description: Rewrite all reftables into a single compacted table, optionally expiring reflog entries.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_required
methods.description: Determine whether the stack requires compaction based on heuristics or other criteria.

methods.name: reftable_stack_auto_compact
methods.description: Perform automatic heuristics-based compaction of the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_clean
methods.description: Remove stale reference tables from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_ref
methods.description: Read a single ref from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_log
methods.description: Read a single log entry from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_stats
methods.description: Retrieve statistics on past compactions.

methods.name: reftable_stack_hash_id
methods.description: Get the hash identifier of the current stack.

ctags.name: attempts
ctags.pattern: /^	int attempts; \/* how often we tried to compact *\/$/

ctags.name: bytes
ctags.pattern: /^	uint64_t bytes; \/* total number of bytes written *\/$/

ctags.name: entries_written
ctags.pattern: /^	uint64_t entries_written; \/* total number of entries written, including$/

ctags.name: failures
ctags.pattern: /^	int failures; \/* failures happen on concurrent updates *\/$/
